a.lede: The FAA grounded flights for hours on November 13, and the transportation secretary blamed it on old and malfunctioning air traffic control system.
a.title: FAA allows flights to resume after hours-long ground stop across the US

b.lede: Normally, aviation is slow to embrace new technology—but AI has come for the skies.
b.title: No Pilots. Few Air Traffic Controllers. What Could Go Wrong?
